changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Create ai_sensitive_patterns table for managing AI sensitive data detection patterns
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE ai_sensitive_patterns MODIFY COLUMN pattern_name VARCHAR(200) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, MODIFY COLUMN pattern_description VARCHAR(500) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, MODIFY COLUMN pattern_regex VARCHAR(500) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, MODIFY COLUMN detection_reason VARCHAR(200) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, MODIFY COLUMN sample_value VARCHAR(100) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, MODIFY COLUMN is_active TINYINT(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT 1;

ALTER TABLE ai_sensitive_patterns ALTER COLUMN pattern_name TYPE VARCHAR(200) COLLATE "en_US.utf8", ALTER COLUMN pattern_description TYPE VARCHAR(500) COLLATE "en_US.utf8", ALTER COLUMN pattern_regex TYPE VARCHAR(500) COLLATE "en_US.utf8", ALTER COLUMN detection_reason TYPE VARCHAR(200) COLLATE "en_US.utf8", ALTER COLUMN sample_value TYPE VARCHAR(100) COLLATE "en_US.utf8";

ALTER TABLE ai_sensitive_patterns ALTER COLUMN pattern_name NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, ALTER COLUMN pattern_description NVARCHAR(500) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, ALTER COLUMN pattern_regex NVARCHAR(500) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, ALTER COLUMN detection_reason NVARCHAR(200) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, ALTER COLUMN sample_value NVARCHAR(100) COLLATE SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS, ALTER COLUMN is_active BIT NOT NULL;
